title: Monotonicity of Fourier weight tails
statement: Let $f$ be any real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $a,b\in\mathbb{R}$ with $a\le b$. The sum of squared Fourier coefficients of $f$ over subsets whose cardinality is greater than $b$ is at most the corresponding sum over subsets whose cardinality is greater than $a$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
